text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm oddly excited.

We decide to drop by the track in the
morning.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The track conditions are exactly as you
said.
There don't seem to be any
problems.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Narita Brian! Good luck in
today's race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
You're going to need it if Rice Shower is
serious!
You can't let your guard down
around the
Assassin!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
She even defeated my precious
McQueen... So
you better be careful if
you don't want to lose!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that was a weird way to show
support.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. I'm not weak
enough for
that to bother me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...All right.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... How far are you planning on
walking with
me? Hurry up and get to
the stands or the staff
seating—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You can do this, Rice... Believe in
yourself...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So you're Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eeek!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, I'm fine. Please, don't worry
about me...

She says that, but her knees are
trembling so
badly she's barely staying
on her feet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that. Here, give me your
hand.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Please don't come any closer! If you do,

misfortune will surely befall you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bad things happen when I'm around.
Everyone
else thinks so too, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for causing you trouble. I'm
completely fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even though your knees are still
shaking?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When someone wins, someone else
loses.
Everybody is someone else's
enemy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The thought of hurting someone else just
by
existing is... scary, sad, and really
awful. But...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I don't want to give up on running...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because there are people that my
running brings
joy to!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Assassin is a title given to those who
know the
weight of their duty.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There aren't many people with that kind
of steel
in their spines... So I'm gonna
put all my soul into
this too.
